title: Decennium Descent Canon Manifest
description: V7 gameplay loop with playtest-supported procedural clarification, stronger public-boundary validation, and empirical balance work explicitly separated.

knowledgeBoundary.publicLimit: The most famous recognized expedition reached the Sixth Gate Guardian and failed.
knowledgeBoundary.haven: The Tier 2.5 Haven is the economic and professional center of dungeon exploration; reaching it profitably is career-defining.
knowledgeBoundary.tierFour: Tier IV introduces unexplained contradictions and gradual Old One symptoms without confirmed cosmological explanation.
knowledgeBoundary.unknown: Tiers VII-X, their Guardians, the Marquis origin, claimant succession, the Old God crystal path, and global failure consequences are Director-only.

combatSpellcastingEconomy.supersedes: Conflicting spellcasting, combat, documented Gate scaling, and economy rules in earlier publications.

classIdentityAndPaths.notes: Seventeen base classes. Expedition roles are functions, not a separate ability corpus. Lich and Necromancer are intentional evil/transgressive dark paths using Traumatic Casting and Resonance Points.

racial.notes: Drakari registry includes Flame, Frost, Storm, Stone, Gale, and Wave variants.

directorContinuity.notes: Contains unknown tiers, full Sixth Gate mechanics, claimant succession, Marquis truth, crystal path, and hidden cosmology.

promotionRules: No parallel live application or duplicate domain Source of Truth.
New packs enter staging and are compared against this manifest before promotion.
Compatibility aliases remain internal and are not published as Decennium Descent creature names.
Stable IDs must be preserved through migrations.
designDoctrine: Decennium Descent should have 5e's readability and speed, Pathfinder 2e's tactical clarity and balance discipline, and its own expedition, extraction, Haven, and seasonal systems.
